fixed.item: P1 gate G7 (STATUS.md: 3.85 vs 3.21 ms per substep): this domain's share, mechanisms.tick 0.028 -> 0.042 ms and mechanisms.slow 0.005 -> 0.007 ms per substep (gate records ADOPT -> P1), and its idle probes in the 1 h wait.
fixed.how: Measured first: the steady-state tick cost equals ADOPT's (0.0153 vs 0.0156 ms on substeps 2-40); the increase is the first builds of four static indexes inside the first substep (pet_doors, ui, heat in the tick or its idle probe, paint in slow), evaluated through the kernel's step-start read views (review M3), plus kind_of building a tag set per record for every door / closer / window / pet-door / alarm index (0.65 us per record). Changes, none altering a result: (1) kind_of rejects a record none of whose type / category / part_type / is_a / tags is a word its inference tests (_KIND_WORDS) before building the set -- same answers, 0.65 -> 0.31 us per record; (2) every index predicate declares the fields it reads (common.INDEX_READS, World.static_index reads=); (3) world._prebuild_indexes (episode_start, order -80, before any hook writes; asserted: nothing journaled) builds the per-substep indexes (common.PER_SUBSTEP_INDEXES: closers, doors, overhead, gas, ui, pet_doors, alarms, heat, paint, glare, sun_windows, panels) on the plain records. An index's content is a pure function of the state, so nothing any system computes changes.
